decisions.decision: Resumed 01-13 as a continuation rather than re-executing from Task 1
decisions.rationale: The safe_resume_gate fired (production commits present, no SUMMARY) but .continue-here.md documented the WIP precisely. That gate exists to catch UNdocumented partial work; documented partial work with an explicit resume instruction is the case it is meant to let through.

decisions.decision: Reverted CAP-01 from Complete back to Pending
decisions.rationale: Plan 01-12 had marked it Complete, contradicting the locked user decision in 01-CONTEXT.md deferring legacy-logger removal to Phase 2. This is a live instance of the project's #1 recorded anti-pattern (first-claimant marking) firing and being caught.

decisions.decision: Shipped WR-01's lock fix WITHOUT new regression coverage
decisions.rationale: The candidate concurrency test passed 5/5 even with the lock reverted — GIL scheduling made the race non-reproducible, so it would have shipped as false-confidence coverage. Recorded as a real, named gap instead. REVIEW.md's alternative (separate producer/consumer HWM fields merged with max() after join()) would be directly assertable if stronger proof is wanted.

decisions.decision: Stopped the background code-fixer mid-run and force-removed its worktree
decisions.rationale: User issued /gsd-pause-work. The removal ran `git worktree remove --force` in the SAME command block as the emptiness check, so an uncommitted in-progress WR-02 edit to src/telemetry/wire/batcher.py was destroyed before the check output could be read. WR-02 was unfixed before and after, so net loss is small — but see the anti-pattern table.

next_action: Run /gsd-autonomous. It resumes at Phase 01 post-execution routing: optionally finish WR-02/03/04 via /gsd-code-review 01 --fix, then regression gate → gsd-verifier → 01-VERIFICATION.md → transition. Then Phases 2–9, all of which are entirely unplanned.
context_notes: Phase 1 is CODE-complete but not CLOSED. All 13 plans have SUMMARYs and the suite is 284 passing, but phase-level verification has never run, so ROADMAP/STATE still show Phase 1 incomplete. The code review surfaced one genuine core-value bug — CR-01: a session that dropped archive frames via queue overflow could still be marked .done and exit 0, directly contradicting 'no run's data is ever lost'. That is fixed, with a subprocess-level regression test verified to fail against pre-fix code. Three Warning findings remain open and are fully specified in 01-REVIEW.md. Phases 2-9 have no CONTEXT.md, no plans, nothing.
